key_insight: Multifidelity Operator Inference combines scarce high-fidelity snapshots with abundant coarse-grid data to reduce surrogate-model variance and improve PDE predictions.
engineering_relevance: More accurate surrogates under limited simulation budgets can make repeated evaluations for uncertainty quantification and engineering design optimization more practical.
method: Collect state and time-derivative data from simulations at multiple discretization fidelities.
Use multifidelity linear regression to estimate reduced operators.
Build a non-intrusive reduced model without accessing the underlying simulation code.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments on model PDE problems show more accurate solution-field predictions than high-fidelity-only Operator Inference at the same computational budget.
watch_item: The abstract reports model-PDE tests but does not establish how performance scales to complex engineering systems or large fidelity gaps.
paper_title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
